mapper.insert: insert ignore into benefit_reconciliation(event_id, outcome, next_check_at) values(#{eventId}, 'READY', now())
mapper.update: update benefit_reconciliation set outcome = 'PROCESSING', claim_token = #{token}, check_count = check_count + 1, lease_until = date_add(now(), interval 5 minute), update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and next_check_at <= now() and (outcome in ('READY', 'PENDING', 'REPLAYED', 'UNAVAILABLE') or (outcome = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until < now()))
mapper.select: select event_id as eventId, outcome, replay_attempts as replayAttempts from benefit_reconciliation where event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: update benefit_reconciliation set outcome = #{outcome}, order_status = #{orderStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, member_status = #{memberStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, detail = #{detail}, next_check_at = case when #{delayMinutes,jdbcType=INTEGER} is null then null else date_add(now(), interval #{delayMinutes,jdbcType=INTEGER} minute) end, claim_token = null, lease_until = null, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and outcome = 'PROCESSING' and claim_token = #{token}
